# Bilal Ahmed | Full-Stack Creative Lead & UI/UX Designer

## Identity & Professional Summary
Bilal Ahmed is a Creative Lead, Graphic Designer, and Full-Stack UI/UX Designer specializing in the intersection of digital branding and technical automation. Based in Gujrat, Pakistan, he serves clients globally, notably in the Scandinavian market (Norway) through Techspace and Squarestech.

He bridges the gap between high-fidelity creative design and robust technical execution. His expertise spans modern web frameworks (Nuxt 3, Vue.js, WordPress), automation platforms (GoHighLevel), and advanced design suites (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite).

## Core Competencies
1. **UI/UX & Web Design**: Designs minimalist, high-impact branding ecosystems aligned with Nordic design principles. Builds pixel-perfect, responsive applications using Nuxt 3, Vue.js, Elementor, and custom HTML/CSS frameworks.
2. **Operations & Automation**: Architects complex workflows in GoHighLevel (GHL) for client onboarding, scalable lead nurturing pipelines, and business operations automation.
3. **Brand Identity**: Creates complete branding ecosystems, large-format print media, vector logos, and social media assets.
4. **Paid Ads & Lead Generation**: Drives measurable revenue through data-driven Meta Ads, LinkedIn campaigns, and A/B tested ad creatives.

## Professional Experience
- **Creative Lead & Operations Manager at Squarestech** (May 2025 - Present): Manages on-site operations and multidisciplinary teams. Designed and developed the company website and architects automation workflows.
- **Remote Creative Lead at Techspace** (May 2025 - Present): Provides high-level visual identity and web design solutions specifically tailored for the Scandinavian tech market.
- **Graphic Designer at Digitron Solutionz** (March 2022 - March 2025): Designed print media, digital assets, and executed video editing strategies for high-volume local advertising.
